newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mixed on Friday, after technical buying by local investors supported the market in the morning session, traders said.
Prices ranged from 160 yen lower to 10 yen higher, with the benchmark May 1998 closing steady at 14,040 yen a tonne. The day's estimated trade volume was 47,090 lots.

All contracts gained at the opening, due to technical buying by local investors, traders said. But price losses in the soybean market turned the mood bearish later, and some contracts erased earlier gains, they said.
At 0833 GMT, the spot May corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was at $2.84 per bushel, down from the $2.84-3/4 Thursday close.
The spot May soybean contract on the CBOT overnight trading system stood at $8.52-1/4 per bushel, against the previous close of $8.62.
